items.title: Qwen-Drive-1.0: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for Autonomous Driving
items.summary: Researchers introduce Qwen-Drive-1.0, a new vision-language foundation model designed to enhance autonomous driving capabilities by integrating visual and linguistic understanding.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Acquires Thrive-backed Console for $500M
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks reportedly acquired Console, a Thrive-backed company, for $500 million, signaling significant consolidation in the cybersecurity sector, potentially leveraging AI for defense.

items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to Feature 'Real World AI Stage' with Nvidia and Robotics
items.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will introduce a new 'Real World AI Stage' showcasing advancements from Nvidia, robotics, and discussions on AI's practical applications, highlighting the growing focus on tangible AI solutions.

items.title: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills with Repo-To-Skill
items.summary: Repo-To-Skill proposes a method to distill complex GitHub repositories into discrete AI-for-AI skills, potentially streamlining the development and integration of AI components.

items.title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
items.summary: New research on SMELT explores scaling laws for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) looped transformers, offering insights into more efficient and powerful large language model architectures.

items.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
items.summary: SolarWM introduces open data and scalable training techniques for long-horizon video world models, pushing the boundaries of AI's ability to understand and predict complex visual sequences.

items.title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
items.summary: H3-World presents a novel approach to translate language understanding directly into control over simulated or real-world environments, advancing the field of AI agents.

items.title: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers Corporate Request Mix from Production Traffic
items.summary: This paper details a practical approach to building and fine-tuning a self-hosted Large Language Model (LLM) using real-world production traffic to meet specific corporate needs.

items.title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs as Generalist Vision-Language-Action Agents for Drone Control
items.summary: Researchers evaluate multimodal LLMs as versatile agents for drone control, demonstrating their potential in complex tasks like commanding, approaching, tracking, and searching.

items.title: EarlyEval: Cheaper Agent Evaluation via Early Outcome Prediction
items.summary: EarlyEval proposes a method for more cost-effective AI agent evaluation by predicting outcomes earlier in the process, potentially accelerating development cycles.

items.title: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention
items.summary: New research demonstrates that language models can be designed to control their own attention mechanisms, offering a path towards more interpretable and efficient AI systems.

items.title: I Tried Pair Programming With Three Different AI Tools For a Month
items.summary: A developer shares their month-long experience pair programming with three different AI tools, offering practical insights into the current state and effectiveness of AI in software development workflows.

items.title: Execution Trees, Not More Logs: A Better Debugging Model for AI Agents
items.summary: This article advocates for 'execution trees' as a superior debugging model for AI agents compared to traditional logs, promising clearer insights into agent behavior and decision-making.

items.title: Proactive Cyber Defense for Governments and Enterprises with Google's Fairwind Program
items.summary: Google's AI Blog introduces the Fairwind program, focusing on proactive cyber defense strategies powered by AI for government and enterprise clients to enhance security.

items.title: How AI-Native Companies Turn Workflows into Operating Capability
items.summary: OpenAI explores how companies built around AI are transforming their internal workflows into core operating capabilities, showcasing best practices for leveraging AI at an organizational level.
